text_block_list.text:
The heated race comes to an end.
Winning
Ticket, having defeated Biwa
Hayahide and
Нарита Таисин, reflects on
her triumph.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At the same time, she is worried about
the
growing threat of Taishin and her
fierce sprinting
ability.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Shaking off her uneasiness, Ticket forces
herself
to focus squarely on the
Japanese Derby, where
she can't afford
to lose.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
